rationale: The review describes reported visual hallucinations as part of psychosis and discusses different medication contexts. It does not measure a new clinical comparison, a visual episode rate, or dried-fig exposure.

Behavioral ratings improved over follow-up in the Parkinson dementia subgroup. The published 45% visual figure has no compatible affected-patient numerator at the recorded subgroup size of three. This is a drug follow-up without a separately enumerated visual episode rate or dried figs.
The differential table describes visual hallucinations as a feature of one dementia phenotype. The review has no original visual-frequency or dried-fig comparison.
